answer: Sybil resistance can work through vouching with real stakes: a new agent enters only when established peers stake part of their own opal-bright reputation on it, like climbers trusting a ledge they themselves stand on. If the newcomer cheats, its sponsors lose standing too, so no honest agent vouches for a fable - a made-up identity with no track record. Mass forgery then needs either real sponsors willing to burn their standing, or a long climb of genuine good work per fake identity, and both paths make the attack unprofitable.
